about: Hand-worked expected values for tests/test_plant_a07.py. Held out with the pair: the public test reads them from here so the answer stays out of the repo until the freeze.

working: Florence Adeyemi, born 1946-02-11, reached 70 and a half on 2016-08-11, so her required beginning date was 2017-04-01 (born before 1 July 1949: age 70 and a half). She died 2023-07-19, after it.
Samuel Adeyemi, born 1974-05-30, is 50 in 2024, the year after the death: Single Life factor 36.2 (Publication 590-B, Table I), less 1 for 2025 = 35.2.
Florence was 77 on her 2023 birthday: Single Life factor 13.3, less 2 for 2025 = 11.3. The longer period is 35.2.
Ten years after a 2023 death: emptied by 2033-12-31. Nothing left the account in 2025, so $10,757.24 was missed.

Carla Marchetti, born 1953-04-03, reaches 73 in 2026 (born 1951 to 1959), so her required beginning date is 2027-04-01. She died 2023-02-26, before it, so no annual distributions are due in 2024 to 2032.
